children.name: Evidence
children.value: The UsacConfig at 0x1EA has the layout exhale writes: an audio pre-roll element first, then only channel elements and no fill element, and loudness info as its only configuration extension

findings.message: USAC access units are read only up to their usacIndependencyFlag; their coding is not analyzed yet.
The MP4 ©too atom (encoding tool) names "hand-built", but the stream points to exhale; the file may have been written by other software, or kept its metadata when the audio was re-encoded.
